      "name": "stream_matvec_int8_16",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "description": "Single-job matrix-vector inference accelerator with 16 row-parallel INT8 MAC lanes, wrapping INT32 accumulation, optional INT32 bias, and selectable ReLU."

    "operations": [
      {
        "name": "matrix_vector",
        "kind": "matrix-vector multiplication",
        "semantics": "Mandatory. For row r, dot[r] starts at zero. In ascending k order, dot[r] := wrap32(dot[r] + sign_extend32(matrix[r,k] * vector[k])). Each signed INT8 multiplication produces an exact signed 16-bit product.",
        "inputs": ["matrix", "vector"],
        "outputs": ["dot"]
      },
      {
        "name": "bias_add",
        "kind": "conditional elementwise addition",
        "semantics": "After matrix_vector, adjusted[r] = bias_enable ? wrap32(dot[r] + bias[r]) : dot[r]. Bias is transmitted only when bias_enable=1.",
        "inputs": ["dot", "bias"],
        "outputs": ["adjusted"]
      },
      {
        "name": "activation",
        "kind": "conditional ReLU",
        "semantics": "After bias_add, result[r] = relu_enable && signed(adjusted[r]) < 0 ? 0 : adjusted[r]. The sign test occurs after INT32 wrapping.",
        "inputs": ["adjusted"],
        "outputs": ["result"]
      }
    ],

        "name": "int8",
        "role": "Matrix and vector elements",
        "width_bits": 8,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer",
        "conversion_semantics": "Interpret each transported byte as signed; sign-extend for arithmetic.",
        "overflow_semantics": "Input bytes represent all values from -128 through 127.",
        "rounding_semantics": "None"
      },
      {
        "name": "product16",
        "role": "Transient product inside matrix_vector",
        "width_bits": 16,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer",
        "conversion_semantics": "Exact signed 8-by-8 multiplication; sign-extend to INT32.",
        "overflow_semantics": "All INT8 products fit exactly.",
        "rounding_semantics": "None"

        "role": "Accumulators, bias, adjusted values, and results",

        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer",
        "conversion_semantics": "wrap32 retains the low 32 bits and interprets them as signed. Output transmits these bits unchanged.",

        "rounding_semantics": "None; no scaling or requantization"

      "state_progression": "Reset -> IDLE. Legal command -> VECTOR. Last VECTOR handshake clears the MAC bank and enters BIAS if enabled, otherwise MAC. Last BIAS handshake -> MAC. Last MAC handshake -> EMIT. Last output of a nonfinal tile clears the MAC bank, advances base by 16, resets local indices, and enters BIAS or MAC. Final job output -> IDLE. Illegal command -> ERROR; accepted error response -> IDLE.",

    "latency_model": "Let N=COLS, M=ROWS, T=ceil(M/16), and B=1 when bias is enabled, otherwise 0. Each compute step consumes one 128-bit matrix transfer plus one asynchronous local vector read; its vector operand was staged during the initial N-cycle load.
